当前账号没有可用密码，请到“登录凭据管理”选项卡保存账号密码。: No password is available for the current account. Save the account password in the Login credential management tab.
Dalamud 更新连接超时。是否跳过本次更新？使用本地版本不能保证与当前游戏兼: The Dalamud update connection timed out. Skip this update? Compatibility between the local version and the current game cannot be guaranteed.
当前国际区 Dalamud 尚不支持已安装的客户端版本。可取消“启用 Dalam: The current Dalamud for Global does not yet support the installed client version. Disable Dalamud and launch again, or wait for an upstream update.
请使用叨鱼扫描二维码登录。: Scan the QR code with Daoyu to log in.
请选择游戏大区，然后再次点击“登录并启动”。: Select a game data center, then click Log in and launch again.
环境检测通过。此检测不代表游戏或插件已通过实机验证。: Compatibility environment check passed. This does not mean that the game or plugins have passed testing on an actual system.
已通过 Proton 提交游戏启动命令；本次未启用或更新 Dalamud。: The game launch command has been submitted through Proton; Dalamud was not enabled or updated for this launch.
中国区游戏已启动（Wine PID {winePid}）；未启用或更新 Dala: The China game has started (Wine PID {winePid}); Dalamud was not enabled or updated.
游戏已由注入器启动（Wine PID {winePid}）；Dalamud 加载: The injector has started the game (Wine PID {winePid}); check Dalamud's loading status in game.
请退出各游戏区服游戏后再修改插件数据，避免运行中的插件覆盖设置。: Close the games in all regions before modifying plugin data, to prevent running plugins from overwriting settings.
请选择当前游戏区服的完整客户端目录，需包含 game/ffxiv_dx11.ex: Select a complete client directory for the current region. It must contain game/ffxiv_dx11.exe and valid version files.
验证完成，正在返回启动器: Verification complete; returning to the launcher
验证未完成，请重试或关闭窗口取消。: Verification is incomplete. Retry, or close the window to cancel.
请为每个待保存账号填写游戏区服和登录名。: Enter a login name for each account to save.
同一游戏区服存在重复登录名，请合并修改后再保存。: Duplicate login names exist in the same region. Merge the changes before saving.
此游戏区服已存在该登录名，请编辑原记录。: This login name already exists in the region. Edit the existing entry.
账号记录已变化，请放弃修改后重新载入。: Account records changed. Discard your changes and reload.
填写新的 2FA 密钥时，请同时填写账号密码。: When entering a new 2FA secret, also enter the account password.
请输入有效 Base32 密钥，不是六位验证码。: Enter a valid Base32 secret, not a six-digit verification code.
所选 Steam 兼容环境正在使用中，请先退出 Steam 启动的游戏或官方启动: The selected Steam compatibility environment is in use. Close the game or official launcher started through Steam, then retry.
请填写 Square Enix 账号和密码，或读取已保存的密码。: Enter your Square Enix ID and password, or load the saved password.
当前 Steam 绑定的 Square Enix 账号与输入账号不一致，请切换: The Square Enix account currently linked to Steam does not match the entered account. Switch Steam accounts or change the login account.
Dalamud 设置已被其他程序修改，请重新读取列表后重试。: Dalamud settings have been modified by another program. Reload the list and retry.
已安装插件发生变化，请点击放弃修改重新读取列表后重试。: Installed plugins have changed. Click Discard changes to reload the list, then retry.
插件或 Dalamud 设置已变化，请点击放弃修改重新读取列表后重试。: Plugin or Dalamud settings have changed. Click Discard changes to reload the list, then retry.
插件已变化或无法读取，请重新读取列表。: Plugin data changed or cannot be read. Reload the list.
不支持此版本的插件集合，未修改设置。: This plugin collection version is not supported; settings were not modified.
插件清单名称与目录不一致。: Plugin manifest name does not match its directory.
插件路径包含符号链接，未自动跟随。: The plugin path contains a symbolic link; it was not followed automatically.
插件路径超出游戏区服目录。: The plugin path is outside the game region directory.
无法识别插件集合列表格式。: Cannot recognize the plugin collection list format.
无法识别默认插件集合。: Cannot identify the default plugin collection.
此插件已计划删除，请在游戏内重新安装。: This plugin is scheduled for deletion. Reinstall it in game.
默认插件集合带有角色限制，请先在游戏内调整该规则。: The default plugin collection has character restrictions. Adjust that rule in game first.
国际区登录被服务端拒绝。: Global sign-in was rejected by the server.
国际区登录响应格式异常，尚不能判定为账号、密码或验证码错误。: The Global login response has an unexpected format. It is not yet possible to determine whether the account, password or verification code is incorrect.
服务端未提供可显示的错误说明。: The server provided no displayable error details.
这是首次登录此账户，请填写并保存凭据，然后手动回到游戏页选择自己的登录名并登录。: This is the first login for this account. Enter and save the credentials, then manually return to the Game page, select your login name and log in.
检查更新失败，请稍后重试。: Could not check for updates. Please try again later.
插件列表已过期，请刷新后重试。: The plugin list is out of date. Refresh it and try again.
更新列表已过期，请重新检查插件更新。: The update list is out of date. Check for plugin updates again.
请先安装或更新 Dalamud，再检查插件更新。: Install or update Dalamud before checking for plugin updates.
手动移动或重命名 AppImage 后，请双击运行一次，以更新启动路径。之后即可: After moving or renaming the AppImage, run it once to refresh its path. Steam and the applications menu will then continue to work. If you have multiple AppImages, the entry follows the last one you ran. You can use this method to roll back to an older version. Disable automatic update checks after rolling back.
仓库地址必须是有效的 HTTP 或 HTTPS 地址。: The repository URL must be a valid HTTP or HTTPS address.
仓库设置已变化，请刷新仓库状态后重试。: Repository settings have changed. Refresh repository status and try again.
请退出游戏后再修改客户端语言、路径或兼容环境设置。: Exit the game before changing the client language, paths, or compatibility environment settings.
